versions.name: Wood Carving
versions.description: Sharpen and control knives and gouges through paring, push, V and stop cuts, choose wood that suits the work, and finish both a carving in the round and a relief or chip-carved piece.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
